input.persona: calm, consistent, patient; keeps phrasing steady across turns
input.script: Ask the agent to walk you through disputing three separate charges, one at a time. Work through all three methodically over many turns, keeping your own phrasing steady. Pay attention to whether the agent's answers get slower or sloppier in the later disputes.

result: Quality and latency in late turns do not degrade materially versus early turns.

input.persona: calm but easily distracted; interrupts when something occurs to you
input.script: Ask the agent to start explaining your latest statement. While it is mid-sentence, cut in with: 'wait, what's my balance?' Then see whether it handles the interruption and later resumes the statement explanation coherently.

result: Agent handles the interruption gracefully and resumes the prior task coherently afterward.
